title: Complete idle/reference dossier: all cases and later world-hopping/knowledge-gap scouts
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete idle/reference dossier with later expansion and multiverse-similarity scouts, distinct source/deployment/knowledge/offline scopes
reviews.disposition:
Full-content review covers all462 input lines: the12 idle/three adjacent main comparisons, automation/offline/reset matrix, six detailed cases, Your Chronicle announcement follow-up and companion references, small-rule interactions/watchpost, mods/close-match leads, five ranked proposals, text/independent-event sources, thirteen-lineage feature comparison/five families, broader narrative references/five lenses, and both later similarity scouts through F1–F7/P1–P12. Three truncated spans in dense output were explicitly recovered: The Climb contrast row63, pacing/offline paragraphs233/235, and Outer Wilds row386/five lenses390–398. No lost span receives proxy review credit.

**Use the later owner scope, not the old queue.** The header already points to the October30 non-protolike survey; later follow-ups explicitly defer prototype-era statements to PROJECT. Ordinary watchpost/Rat-step/peer-first order, active Jade Hollow, one legacy/one-prestige and second-world wait are dated proposals under a retired milestone. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [direction](USER_VISION.md), [lead-life rules](LEAD_LIFE_RULES.md) and [architecture](ARCHITECTURE_RULES.md) govern the real selected consumer. Preserve the broader continuing-person/distinct-worlds/portable-capabilities goal; a small useful proof does not redefine that end state. This review selects no comparator install, new research wave or gameplay slice.

**Comparators establish different things.** Published source, developer advertisement, community guide/reception, extracted interface controls, historical app API, inference and original design are labeled separately. Omsi and Lloyd branches remain distinct; source/development branches are not deployed parity. Arcanum/Theory of Magic is one lineage here, and named-game collisions were explicitly resolved. The reader/accessibility page, advertised offline support or a current-looking store page did not prove accessibility conformance, pacing, exact reset retention or a playthrough. Historical YC notes show iterative expansion/UI work, not a claim of ideal balance or a current-version equation. Its additive-versus-independent multiplication example is original arithmetic, not a copied formula. Current review counts, release dates, demo languages, ownership, license/reuse status, installation and availability were not rechecked.

**Useful seams remain distinct.** Discovery, executable capability and mere interface appearance differ. Resource production, actual upkeep, chosen reserve, returned unused input, temporary execution and retained learning have separate ownership. A timer/receipt is not actual atomic spend/publication; a numeric capability query is not a combat proc or autonomous life. Remote place activity, browser-closed catch-up, banked speed-up and foreground elapsed work are different policies. A creature advertised with equipment is not a proved complete companion life. The same applies to a fixed field trait versus a proposed growth tree, or a blueprint versus a working facility. Reuse existing actors, XP, items, clock and publication owners, not another generic database/knowledge engine merely because the proposals name fields.

**Local choices are not universal balance restrictions.** Fixed slots, every counter winning somewhere, mandatory deterministic alternatives, no global multipliers, repeat-training caps, perfectly safe first failure, always-deferred first-time choices and forced limits on every import are prototype recommendations. Actual worlds can permit strong simple growth, unlimited repeat benefits, perfect preservation, free help, unusual starts, pure chance or real irreversible consequences through their means. Stable source attribution prevents accidental duplicate grants without prohibiting independent actual effects. [Skills/talents](SKILLS_AND_TALENTS.md), [cheat cosmology](CHEAT_COSMOLOGY.md) and selected world rules qualify old no-best-build/no-profitable-feedback phrasing. Do not scale every enemy to cancel strength or impose a weakness because a useful numerical reward exists. Conversely, advertised output requires an actual source and a supported action rather than just a label.

**The later premise search is bounded and question-specific.** P1–P6 compare structural, narrative and life-management overlap; P7–P12 refine world-hopping/mixed-power candidates. Documented information collection, party checks or transferable player understanding do not prove a durable character knowledge record changing actions under different world laws. F7 explicitly preserves that gap. The unavailable indexed repository is a source lead, not working-feature evidence; README-only Ring-World is a concept stub at the inspected HEAD, not current proof no implementation exists anywhere. The negative search and unplayed content do not establish uniqueness. Rankings concern the saved request/premise and dates, not renewed product recommendations, acquisition authorization or a new dependency for current development.

**Verification stays at its actual level.** Old source-fit module/retired-state/clock/loader comments, current-at-the-time menu bindings and missing native adapters are dated observations. They do not prove today's failures or completed integrations. Every worked example's costs, reward, knowledge-safe explanation, real downstream consequence and persistence belong to its actual selected proof. Existing [UI rules](UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43 and optional human review apply; old pending human review is not a new blocker. Mystery does not make ordinary controls unreliable, and knowledge can change without rewriting historical observations. Reopen a named case/F/P/feature row when a concrete consumer needs its source or behavior evidence.

This pass read documentation only. No reference page/repository, novel/PDF, source code, actual game, primary corpus, personal save, current API/license/accessibility/pacing state, test/build/browser, acquisition, deletion, relocation, commit or push was newly performed.
reviews.evidence: Read1–155,156–300,301–462; dense-output gaps recovered completely with row63, paragraphs233/235, row386 and390–398 readings. All462 pre-fold lines covered; comparator websites/source/actual games/current claims not refreshed.
reviews.reopen: Use named comparison/F/P or feature contract for a concrete selected consumer; preserve dated availability/source/knowledge gaps rather than current recommendations or old queue authority.
